page.overview:
Who is Pit Viper?

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;" width="900"

Pit Viper first came out in a two-pack with a Night Force version of Duke as part of the Spy Troops toyline. He came with two machine guns and a belt as his accessories. [http://www.yojoe.com/action/03/pitviper.shtml YoJoe.com page]/[http://www.yojoe.com/filecard/03/pitviper.shtml Filecard]

A second Pit Viper action figure is as part of Valor vs. Venom's vehicle lineup. The entire figure is made from the same mold as the original, came in an all-black color scheme and a belt as his only accessory. [http://www.yojoe.com/action/05/pitviper2.shtml YoJoe.com page]/[http://www.yojoe.com/filecard/05/pitviper2.shtml Filecard]
